# OpenCode Go

Sample upstream document (structure mirrors the real go.mdx) used to replay
`watch_go.py` offline in tests.

## Usage limits

OpenCode Go includes the following base limits:

- **5 hour limit** — $12 of usage

| Model            | requests per 5 hour | requests per week | requests per month |
| ---------------- | ------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------ |
| Grok 4.6         | 169                 | 423               | 845                |
| Sample Bot       | 1,000               | 2,500             | 5,000              |
| Freebie          | -                   | -                 | -                  |
| Claude Sonnet 5  | 100                 | 250               | 500                |

| Model            | Input | Output | Cached Read | Cached Write | Usage |
| ---------------- | ----- | ------ | ----------- | ------------ | ----- |
| Grok 4.6         | $0.20 | $0.80  | $0.02       | $0.10        | $20   |
| Sample Bot       | $0.30 | $1.20  | $0.06       | $0.375       | $60   |
| Freebie          | $0    | $0     | $0          | $0           | -     |
| Claude Sonnet 5  | $3.00 | $15.00 | $0.30       | $0.75        | $50   |
